tidbit: Did you know… one story this hour was carried by nine different outlets in the last few hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Most U.S. voters say Trump and Congress aren't taking artificial intelligence risks seriously, according to a poll confirmed by The Beatrice Daily Sun.
Lila Ibrahim from Google DeepMind urges graduates to reskill and adapt as careers shift in the artificial intelligence age, reported by NDTV.
An artificial intelligence data centre firm backed by Nvidia has scrapped its initial public offering as valuation concerns in the sector deepen, reported by BBC.
Three hundred publishers are pushing for disclosure rules on artificial intelligence bots amid content licensing deals and legal challenges, reported by The Cryptonomist.
Silicon Valley leaders are rebranding artificial intelligence as super intelligence to align with Trump's push on the terminology, confirmed by The Verge.
Free every hour.
